osm.geometry_selection: Whole source ways intersecting bbox, without artificial end nodes. boundary_crossing marks overhang.
osm.tags: Complete source tags preserved as UTF-8 JSON string; node_ids correspond to geometry vertices.

overture.columns: id, geometry, class, subclass, name, sources, connectors, speed_limits, road_surface, road_flags, access_restrictions, level_rules, bbox, version
overture.selection: road subtype, bbox intersection; source segment geometry retained

photos.sampling: Spatial tiles, interleaved sequences and spaced frames; reviewed non-road images and identical SHA-256 duplicates removed. Mapillary photographs are associated with selected speed-limit map features, not a random city sample.
photos.width_height: Manifest records final thumbnail dimensions; is_panorama is an aspect-ratio heuristic (>2.5), not an authoritative projection type.

mapillary.sign_scope: Selected regulatory maximum-speed-limit classes g1, spatially tiled bounded API sample, not a complete city inventory. Saturated tiles can omit features.
mapillary.sign_license: ODbL-1.0 (public derived metadata under Mapillary OSM compatibility permission)
mapillary.image_api: Graph API v4 per-image metadata; /images search returned HTTP 500. Image IDs obtained from map_features.images.

links.bearing: Local tangent within +/-5 m of projected camera position, converted back to true-north geodesic bearing. bearing_diff is minimum forward/reverse angular difference (0-90 degrees).
links.ranking: distance_m + bearing_diff/9; missing heading contributes 5 m to rank. Ties broken by distance then OSM id. Alternative score within 2 m marks ambiguous_candidates.
links.overture: Prefer a source-record reference to the chosen OSM way within 25 m of the camera, otherwise a spatial fallback within 25 m.
links.direction: camera heading is not travel direction; camera_against_way_direction is a review flag, not an access violation.
links.status: Input candidates, not ground-truth assignment or conflict verdicts.

reference.method: Visual inspection of each reference photograph; uncertainty stored per label. Three questions on 80 Panoramax photographs and four on 20 Mapillary photographs.
reference.scope: Labels for measuring image interpretation quality; no map-error verdicts.
